text: D225298 was explicitly accepted while the reviewer still reported an intermittent getComputedStyle error. The author then added the documentElement guard. The applied guard prevents that call without a document root. The review’s MsgLoaded timing theory remains a hypothesis, and the guard does not establish complete message readiness or resolve every later race. title: Keep the DarkReader document-root guard separate from reviewer readiness speculation
